run_stereo_flow_test: run the test script to evaluate a CroCo model on stereo or optical flow datasets
test_model_with_tiled_pred: test a CroCo model using tiled prediction with configurable overlap and confidence mode
save_predictions_and_metrics: save model predictions, visualizations, error maps, and metrics to disk after evaluation
load_model_and_criterion: load a pretrained CroCo model checkpoint along with its task-specific metrics object
generate_submission_files: generate submission files for stereo or flow datasets using the model predictions
